results.title: Builder Can’t Use COVID Excuse If Possession Was Due Before Pandemic
results.description: MahaREAT holds that promoters already in default before COVID cannot claim moratorium benefit to reduce interest for delayed possession under Section 18 of RERA. The post Builder Can’t Use COVID Excuse If Possession Was Due Before Pandemic appeared first on Square Feat India .

results.title: ‘I wish it could have gone forever’: Gord Sinclair remembers the Tragically Hip’s final tour
results.description: Gord Sinclair can still picture the Tragically Hip in a rehearsal room, five musicians tossing ideas back and forth until a song emerged that none could have written alone. Ten years after the iconic Kingston, Ont.
